# Zealver Clubs

> Zealver Clubs runs joyful, chair-based Zealver Seated Dance Fitness for women 60+, online and in person from Mumbai (Andheri), alongside a growing Knowledge Hub of activity-first guidance for healthy ageing. Tagline: "Healthy Ageing, Done Together, Fun. Friendship. Fitness."

Key facts:
- Who it is for: women 60+ (seniors). Younger people are welcome by choice, but everything is designed for older adults.
- What it offers: (1) Experiences, Zealver Seated Dance Fitness classes online and in person, plus clubs and paid events/workshops; (2) Knowledge Hub, trusted, activity-first (non-medical) reading on healthy ageing.
- Approach: the 4Ms, Movement, Music, Memory, Meaning, in a simple weekly rhythm. Chair-based and music-led; no dance or fitness experience needed.
- Sessions: typically twice weekly. Online batches run worldwide (members join from across India and abroad); in-person clubs are based in Mumbai (Andheri), with a South Bombay branch planned.
- Content model: each Knowledge Hub subject is a "Topic" (one subject) or a "Guide" (a step-by-step walkthrough that links several Topics). Many topics are video-first (YouTube) with a readable write-up and a listen (read-aloud) option.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 91521 58933, email info@zealverclubs.com.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/zealverclubs/

## Experiences
- [Experiences](https://zealverclubs.com/experience): choose In-Person or Online seated dance fitness; browse clubs, events and instructors.
